> I have a friend. He lives in London.\<br\>→ I have a friend **who lives in London**.

Antes\<br\>Después &lt;br&gt;**negrita**

| Pronombre | Significado | Se usa para | Ejemplo |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| who | Quien &lt;br&gt;Que | personas | The man who lives here is a doctor. |
| whom | A quién&lt;br&gt;A que | personas como objeto, formal | The woman whom I met was nice. |
| whose | Cuyo/a/os/as | posesión | The girl whose car was stolen called the police. |
| which | Que<br>El cual<br>La cual | cosas / animales | The book which I bought is interesting. |
| that | que | personas o cosas | The movie that we watched was good. |
| where | donde | lugares | This is the house where I grew up. |
| when | cuando | tiempo | I remember the day when we met. |
| formatted | **Uno&lt;br&gt;Dos** | `<br>` | `a\|b` |
